name: Table Mountain
desc: The flat-topped icon. Ride the cableway — or hike Platteklip for free and earn the entire city at your feet.

name: Lion's Head
desc: The sunrise-hike rite of passage. Two oceans, one spiral path, zero entry fee.

name: Boulders Beach
desc: Penguins. Actual wild penguins waddling past your toes, for roughly the price of a burger.

name: Kirstenbosch Gardens
desc: A botanical garden spilling down the mountainside, with a treetop walkway. Prime picnic-and-dream territory.

name: Robben Island
desc: The ferry to Mandela's cell, with former prisoners as guides. Heavy, humbling, and worth every saved rand.

name: Cape of Good Hope
desc: Cliffs, cheeky baboons, and that end-of-the-continent feeling where two oceans meet to gossip.

name: V&A Waterfront
desc: Harbour buzz, buskers, and giant food halls. Watching seals dodge yachts is free entertainment.

name: Bo-Kaap
desc: Candy-coloured houses on cobbled slopes with koesisters close by. Bring your camera, not your wallet.

name: Sea Point Promenade
desc: The city's shared front porch — joggers, dogs, and sunsets where the Atlantic shamelessly shows off.

name: Camps Bay Beach
desc: White sand with the Twelve Apostles looming behind you. The tan is free; the cocktails are not.
